**Finding: Compliant** (no redline proposed)

Section 22 satisfies the AUDIT rule's **preferred** position on every material term:

| Rule parameter | Preferred | Document (§22) |
|---|---|---|
| Frequency | ≤ once / 12 months | once in any twelve-month period ✓ |
| Notice | 30 days' written | at least thirty days' prior written ✓ |
| Timing/manner | business hours | normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption ✓ |
| Auditor | independent, confidentiality-bound | same, plus off-site where practicable ✓ |
| Cost | Vendor unless underpayment > 5% | Vendor unless underpayment exceeds five percent ✓ |
| System access | none | Vendor and auditor may not access Customer systems directly, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential info ✓ |

Section 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (findings are our Confidential Information, enforcement-only use, copy of the final report, finality on payment absent fraud or demonstrable error). Section 23 ("Records and Customer Assurance") is a bare heading with no substantive assurance obligations, so it creates no additional audit exposure. Nothing here falls to the fallback or into walk-away territory, so no edits are warranted.
